# v4.2.2 Fix remote paste on CRLF builds

## 中文说明

修复 v4.2.1 预编译版在 Ubuntu/Debian 等服务器（`/bin/sh` 为 dash 或 bash）上远程粘贴必定失败、托盘提示 `SSH 连接已关闭：sh: 2: set: Illegal option` 的问题。

原因是构建时内嵌的远程 worker 脚本带有 CRLF 行尾，远端 shell 把行尾 `\r` 当成非法的 `set` 选项而退出。现在运行时会去除 `\r`，并新增 `.gitattributes`（`*.sh text eol=lf`）从源头保证脚本为 LF。（#11, #12）

感谢 @nomind2think 定位并修复了这个问题！

### 升级

退出旧版，解压下方 ZIP，用新版 `wsl_clipboard.exe` 替换原程序，保留自己的 `wsl_clipboard.toml` 即可。

## English

Fixes remote paste always failing on Ubuntu/Debian servers (dash or bash as `/bin/sh`) with `set: Illegal option`. The embedded remote worker script had CRLF line endings from the build checkout; the trailing `\r` was read as an invalid `set` option. The helper now strips `\r` at runtime, and a new `.gitattributes` keeps `*.sh` files LF. (#11, #12)

Thanks @nomind2think for tracking down and fixing this!

Exit the old helper, replace the executable and keep your existing TOML configuration.
